THE LANTERN · SKILLS V5
A crew with something
to do together.

Choose companions, formation and equipment before battle. Every fight then plays automatically.

Open the offline demo
Your first evening
Try the practice table. Put a sturdy companion in front, then press Fight.
Open your welcome invitation. Compare the first equipment piece before equipping it.
Explore the route. Read the boss clues and choose a reward when the game offers one.
After a loss, inspect the available improvement or open team preparation.
Visit Companions for skill shapes and combo roles. Place two partners to see a crew hint.

Playback offers speed, pause and skip. There are no skill choices during a fight.

Eight keywords

The plain name explains the rule. Its cafe name appears below it.

Status	What it does	Limit
Burn
Scald
	Lose 12 HP per stack at round end, through shields.	5 stacks · 3 rounds
Bleed
Snag
	Lose 8 HP per stack before your action. Shields absorb it.	5 stacks · 3 rounds
Bitter
Bitter tea
	Receive half as much healing and shielding.	1 stacks · 2 rounds
Mark
Scented
	Take 20% more direct damage and become reachable through the front row.	1 stacks · 2 rounds
Shred
Brittle sugar
	Lose 8% defense and 15 shield per direct hit, per stack.	3 stacks · 2 rounds
Daze
Drowsy
	Your next action becomes a half-power basic. Bosses only lose a signature.	1 stacks · 1 rounds
Regen
Steep
	Heal 18 HP per stack at round end and remove one Burn stack.	3 stacks · 3 rounds
Warm
Cozy
	Take 10% less direct damage per stack. Burn ignores Warm.	3 stacks · 2 rounds

Regen resolves before Burn, then durations expire. Bleed resolves before the bearer acts. Boss damage over time is capped at 6% of maximum HP each round.

Four reactions
Crumb Burst: detonate a target carrying Crumb.
Wildfire: hit a target with three Burn stacks using Splash, Row or All. Nearby foes gain Burn.
Rupture: directly hit a target with Bleed and Shred. Bleed is consumed for damage through shields.
Spread: defeat a Marked target. Its debuffs move to the nearest foe at half stacks, rounded up.

A target triggers at most one reaction per round. Reaction damage cannot start another reaction.

Meet the crews

Oven — Mallow, Cinnamon, Mochi.

Thread — Velvet, Biscuit, Brioche.

Night lamp — Soot, Marigold, Inkcap.

Afternoon tea — Clover, Sorrel, Panko.

These are suggested combo partners, not promises of equal strength. Current balance misses are reported below.

Mochi · Protects primers
Soot · Primes and triggers Crumb Burst
Clover · Answers enemy Burn and Bleed
Panko · Primes Shred for Rupture
Mallow · Primes Burn; triggers Wildfire
Sorrel · Bitter answers healers
Biscuit · Primes Bleed; triggers Rupture
Inkcap · Daze stops boss signatures
Cinnamon · Sustains Burn crews
Brioche · Shred triggers Rupture from the front row
Velvet · Mark and Bleed prime Spread
Marigold · Primes Burn and Crumb Burst
What this build measured

The same 180-battle probe uses seeds 20001–20020 in both modes. The full registered run uses 500 seeds per combat cell.

Metric	V4 fallback	Skills V5	V5 target
Damage actions hitting several foes (%)	9.66	32.57	≥30%
Support actions touching several allies (%)	19.48	29.27	≥35%
Normal fight rounds	13.18	13.34	8–12
Announced reactions per battle	0.00	6.52	≥2

Mochi used Warm welcome in 0.44% of its matched-power actions; Panko used Bread cover in 0.35% of its matched-power actions. The goal is at least 5% use for every skill, with no one skill above 60%. These bot checks measure usage, not human enjoyment.

This lane A demo includes a plain status strip and meta-screen explanations. Lane B’s new badges, body effects and reaction callouts are a separate draft. Human status recognition has not been verified.

Read every gate and remaining miss · Try the fifteen-minute playtest

Keeping your progress

Use Save & settings to export a save code. Old saves still load, with Skills V5 off by default. This separate demo starts with Skills V5 on.

Invitations use earned currency. Exact odds and rules are available in Invitations. No wallet or sign-in is required for this offline demo.

Desktop: 1280×720 or 1440×900; 1024×600 is also checked. The main A4 demo remains separate. Bot measurements are proxies and do not establish human enjoyment.

a5Rows.text:
A5 changes and Skills V5

Home names tonight’s goal and tomorrow’s service. Prepare supports keyboard placement, crew plans and skill shapes. Equipment compares the consequence of a change. Result names contributions and offers an available next step. Battles remain automatic.

Open the separate Skills V5 demo · Read the eight keywords and four reactions · Try the current fifteen-minute playtest

The main A4 demo remains unchanged. Its original guide and measurements are retained below. This section describes the newer preview; lane B’s new battle visuals remain a separate draft.

Current screens
Prepare shows formation, skill shapes and the crew hint. This is the labelled reaction fixture.
The earned-save equipment comparison names the utility change.
Result names the observed reaction. This is the labelled reaction fixture.
Historical A4 and current V5 measurements

The A4 values come from its historical held-out report. Current V5 uses the registered 20001–20500 block. These different samples and configurations are not a same-seed causal estimate. The current report also pairs V5 with its A5 fallback on identical seeds.

Gate	Historical A4	V5 acceptance	V5 status
Adjacent tiers ≥44/48, no reversals	46/48; 0 reversals	37/48; 0 reversals	MISS
Fourth-slot gain ≤12 percentage points	Worst 93.40pp	38/384 misses; worst 48.40pp	MISS
Every set 35–75%, with a leading situation	67.03–79.60%	73.38%–94.35%	MISS
Every cat 55–75%, with a top-pick situation	31.38–64.66%	50.70%–78.72%	MISS
Coherent crew gain 10–25 percentage points	47.73pp	31.20pp	MISS

Historical A4 evidence · Every current gate and remaining miss

Your first week

These are suggested goals, not calendar locks or guaranteed drops. Existing progress requirements and daily limits still apply.

Day	Try this	Earned progress to chase	Tomorrow
1	Place a sturdy cat in front; finish the practice lesson	Free welcome, first route reward	Compare a useful piece; fresh daily allowance
2	Equip one piece and compare its changed stats	Gear discovery, capped board reward	Use earned stamps for another invitation
3	Open an earned invitation; read next-draw odds	Permanent selector marks	Try a different crew combination
4	Try a crew job and standing plan before fighting	A coherent team and journal discoveries	Save a useful loadout
5	Save a shift and compare a spare item	Keep the current kit; chase a matching set	Read the boss's visible guide
6	Read the next boss's intent before the route	Prepare an affordable upgrade	Challenge the next uncleared chapter
7	Challenge the next uncleared chapter	Boss clear and its normal capped rewards	Replay with another crew; fresh daily allowance
